# Generate ActiLife phenotypes

Last updated: `30/03/2026`

**Purpose:** Generate overall activity, step count metrics, time spent in MVPA, LIPA, sedentary behaviour, and sleep using 60s epoch data generated by Actilife.

# Setup

```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE
)

rm(list=ls())
```

Load libraries and specify data folder in here.

```{r load_dependencies}
# Load required packages 
if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(dplyr, data.table, here, lubridate, readr, stringr)
```

```{r}
# Initialise directories and filenames
data_dir <- "path/to/dir"

raine_hip_enmo_epoch_filename <- "raine_epoch_collated_hip_enmo_20260330.csv"
raine_hip_minutemaster_filename <- "hip_minute_master.csv.gz"
raine_hip_sleep_blocks_filename <- "BatchSleepExportDetails(2026-03-10_10-47-11).csv.gz"

output_filename <- "raine_daily_collated_hip_actilife_20260330.csv"

start_hour <- 7
end_hour <- 23
```

# Helper functions

```{r}
#--------------------------
# Shared helper functions
#--------------------------
summarise_enmo <- function(enmo_dt, start_hour = NULL, end_hour = NULL) {
  # Prep datetime fields
  enmo_dt <- enmo_dt %>%
    mutate(
      time = as.POSIXct(time),
      Date = as.Date(time),
      hour = lubridate::hour(time)
    )
  
  # Keep data within specified window
  if (!is.null(start_hour) & !is.null(end_hour)) {
    enmo_dt <- enmo_dt %>%
      filter(hour >= start_hour & hour < end_hour)
  }
  
  # Create daily summaries
  enmo_dt <- enmo_dt %>%
    group_by(participant, Date) %>%
    summarise(overall_activity = mean(enmo_without_nonwear, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(ID = str_split(participant, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]) %>%
    select(-participant)
  
  # Replace NaNs with NA
  enmo_dt <- enmo_dt %>%
    mutate(overall_activity = replace(overall_activity, is.nan(overall_activity), NA_real_))
  
  return(enmo_dt)
}

summarise_activity <- function(minute_dt, enmo_summary = NULL) {
  activity_summary <- minute_dt %>%
    group_by(Filename, Date) %>%
    summarise(
      wear_time_hours = sum(!is.na(activity_cat)) / 60,
      vector_magnitude = mean(vectormagnitude, na.rm = TRUE),
      daily_steps = sum(steps, na.rm = TRUE),
      peak_1_cadence = ifelse(any(!is.na(steps)), max(steps, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
      peak_30_cadence = ifelse(
        any(!is.na(steps)),
        mean(head(sort(steps, decreasing = TRUE), 30), na.rm = TRUE),
        NA_real_
      ),
      mvpa = sum(activity_cat == "mvpa", na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
      lipa = sum(activity_cat == "lipa", na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
      sedentary = sum(activity_cat == "sedentary", na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
      sleep = ifelse(any(activity_cat == "sleep", na.rm = TRUE),
                     sum(activity_cat == "sleep", na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
                     NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Filename = str_split(Filename, "\\.", simplify = TRUE)[, 1],
      ID = str_split(Filename, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
    )

  # Merge ENMO
  if (!is.null(enmo_summary)) {
    activity_summary <- merge(activity_summary,
                              enmo_summary,
                              by = c("ID", "Date"),
                              all = TRUE)
  }
  

  return(activity_summary)
}
```

# Pre-process files

```{r}
# Load minute-level data as data.tables
minute_level_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(data_dir, raine_hip_minutemaster_filename))
sleep_blocks_dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(data_dir, raine_hip_sleep_blocks_filename))
minute_level_enmo <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(data_dir, raine_hip_enmo_epoch_filename),
  data.table = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("NA", "NaN")
)

# Standardise minute-level fields and classify each minute as mvpa/lipa/sedentary.
minute_level_dt[, `:=`(
  timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
  Filename = basename(as.character(filename)),
  Date = as.IDate(timestamp),
  activity_cat = fcase(
    vectormagnitude >= 2690, "mvpa",
    vectormagnitude >= 200, "lipa",
    default = "sedentary"
  )
)]

# Standardise sleep-block columns and parse in-bed/out-of-bed datetimes.
setnames(sleep_blocks_dt, "File Name", "Filename")
sleep_blocks_dt[, `:=`(
  Filename = as.character(Filename),
  sleep_start = parse_date_time(`In Bed Time`, orders = "d/m/Y H:M:S", tz = "UTC"),
  sleep_end = parse_date_time(`Out Bed Time`, orders = "d/m/Y H:M:S", tz = "UTC")
)]

# Create daily ENMO summaries
enmo_daily_summary <- summarise_enmo(
  minute_level_enmo
)

enmo_daily_summary_waking <- summarise_enmo(
  minute_level_enmo,
  start_hour,
  end_hour
)
```

# Generate 24-hour summaries

```{r}
#--------------------------
# 1) 24-hour summary
#--------------------------
minute_24h_dt <- copy(minute_level_dt)

# Reclassify sedentary minutes that overlap sleep windows as sleep.
minute_24h_dt[
  sleep_blocks_dt,
  on = .(Filename, timestamp >= sleep_start, timestamp <= sleep_end),
  activity_cat := data.table::fifelse(activity_cat == "sedentary", "sleep", activity_cat)
]

# Mark non-wear minutes as NA
minute_24h_dt[wearing == "nw", c("activity_cat", "steps") := NA]

# Generate daily summaries
daily_summary_24h <- summarise_activity(
  minute_24h_dt,
  enmo_summary = enmo_daily_summary
) 

# Select and re-order relevant columns
daily_summary_24h <- daily_summary_24h %>%
  select(
    Filename,
    ID,
    Date,
    wear_time_hours,
    overall_activity,
    vector_magnitude,
    daily_steps,
    peak_1_cadence,
    peak_30_cadence,
    mvpa,
    lipa,
    sedentary,
    sleep
  )

# Write output to file
write_csv(daily_summary_24h, output_filename)
cat("Hip 24-hour activity intensity summaries saved to:", output_filename, "\n")
```

# Generate waking-hour summaries

```{r}
#--------------------------
# 2) Waking-hour summary
#--------------------------
minute_waking_dt <- copy(minute_level_dt)

# Filter for waking-hours window
minute_waking_dt <- minute_waking_dt[lubridate::hour(timestamp) >= start_hour &
                                       lubridate::hour(timestamp) < end_hour]

# Mark non-wear minutes as NA
minute_waking_dt[wearing == "nw", c("activity_cat", "steps") := NA]

# Generate daily summaries
daily_summary_wakinghours <- summarise_activity(
  minute_waking_dt,
  enmo_summary = enmo_daily_summary_waking
)

# Select and re-order relevant column
daily_summary_wakinghours <- daily_summary_wakinghours %>%
  select(
    Filename,
    ID,
    Date,
    wear_time_hours,
    overall_activity,
    daily_steps,
    peak_1_cadence,
    peak_30_cadence,
    vector_magnitude,
    mvpa,
    lipa,
    sedentary,
    sleep
  )

# Write output to file
output_filename_waking <- sub("actilife", "actilife_wakinghours", output_filename)
write_csv(daily_summary_wakinghours, output_filename_waking)
cat("Hip waking-hour activity intensity summaries saved to:", output_filename_waking, "\n")
```
